# HAMLET

> HAMLET (https://hamlet.rest) is a shortlet marketplace for Lagos, Nigeria, operated under Abundance Abodes. Its public promise is: “Your stay, sorted.”

## Marketplace & Guest Guides

- [HAMLET Home](https://hamlet.rest/): Discover the marketplace.
- [Explore Lagos Shortlets](https://hamlet.rest/stays): Browse approved shortlet listings.
- [Lagos Neighbourhood Guide](https://hamlet.rest/lagos): Explore Lagos Mainland and Lagos Island neighbourhoods.
- [How HAMLET Works](https://hamlet.rest/how-it-works): Understand booking requests and host confirmation.
- [Guest Safety](https://hamlet.rest/safety): Learn about listing review and booking safeguards.
- [About HAMLET](https://hamlet.rest/about): Learn about HAMLET and its operating principles.
- [Guest FAQs](https://hamlet.rest/faqs): Answers to common guest questions.

## Partner Network

HAMLET supports property owners, authorised agents, property managers and shortlet operators. Partners must have appropriate authority to submit or manage a property. Applicable access, eligibility and commercial arrangements are governed by current written partner terms.

HAMLET provides property owners with access to listing, visibility, booking and property management services. Applicable service fees, verification charges, storage limits and optional paid services will be communicated transparently under HAMLET's current pricing and service policies.

## Legal, Trust & Pricing Policies

- [Legal and Privacy](https://hamlet.rest/legal): Review current marketplace terms and privacy information.
- [Guest booking guidance](https://hamlet.rest/how-it-works): Review the booking request, availability confirmation and payment process.
- [Guest safety](https://hamlet.rest/safety): Understand listing review and guest safeguards.

A booking request is not a confirmed reservation. The host or authorised property partner must confirm availability and applicable terms before payment. Review the total payable amount, applicable charges and any refundable caution deposit in the booking flow before proceeding. A refundable caution deposit is distinct from accommodation charges and is handled under the applicable booking and inspection terms.
